title: Procreate Face Stamps
author: Major.Art
description:
🌸Procreate face stamps, Procreate brushes, 3 Stamp Brushes, fashion girl stamp
🎀This brush set contains 3 stamps.
❤️You can create your own designs with these brushes.
To put a stamp, you need to touch once on the screen. You can change the color of the stamp and the size.
🌸Procreate brushes compatible with the Procreate iPad app only, Procreate Version 5 and higher
Download the brushes file on your iPad, import the brush set to Procreate App.
fullDescription:
🌸Procreate face stamps, Procreate brushes, 3 Stamp Brushes, fashion girl stamp
